name: Yecla
terms: Denominación de Origen, Spain's main quality tier.
Young wine, sold with little or no aging. Some see a few months in oak.

notes: Yecla's very dry climate, arid soils and strong sun give Monastrell wines of good color and high alcohol.
Reds are traditionally made from old Monastrell vines, very rich in tannin.
They are fruity, fleshy and warm, tannic yet smooth, balanced and concentrated.
Rosés are raspberry to cherry pink, fresh and strongly fruity.

blurb.text: A DO covering the municipality of Yecla, in the northernmost corner of Murcia, surrounded by Jumilla, Almansa and Alicante. Monastrell is its main grape, traditionally made into red wine from old vines.
